schema.title: Emission Statement Per Report
schema.description: Describes the statements used in a report.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.

id.description: The Primary Key of the Emission Statement Per Report.

emission_statement_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Statement.

emission_report_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Report.

emission_allocation_kind.description: The optional type of emission allocation assigned to the Emission Statement used in a Report: Activity Emission Allocation, Facility Emission Allocation, Organization Emission Allocation, Organizational Boundary Share.

organizational_boundary_share_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Organizational Boundary Share defining an optional emission allocation percentage assigned to the Emission Statement used in the Report.

activity_emission_allocation_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Activity Emission Allocation defining an optional allocation percentage assigned to the Emission Statement used in the Report.

organization_emission_allocation_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Organization Emission Allocation defining an optional percentage assigned to the Emission Statement used in the Report.

facility_emission_allocation_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Facility Emission Allocation defining an optional percentage assigned to the Emission Statement used in the Report.

emission_activity_category_id.description:
Foreign Key for Emission Activity Category, assuming the statement has been reused under a different context from the original source activity data. For example, Scope 1 Emission Statement transferred to an investor or Joint Venture (JV) partner that interprets the statement as Scope 3, Category 15.

For example, an investor of JV partner requests Scope 1 and Scope 2 Emission Statement data from the asset controller and recasts this as Scope 3, Category 15 Investments based on some Emission Allocation percentage.

emission_scope_type_id.description:
Optional Scope Type assigned to the Emission Statement. An optional part of a composite key for the Emission Activity Category.

This can be used when an Emission Statement is applied with a different scope context by another organization; see Emission Activity Category ID attribute.

emission_reporting_boundary_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Reporting Boundary assigned to the Report.
